summary.text: On Lorwyn-Shadowmoor, a plane whose day and night have slipped out of sync since Oona's defeat, four Strixhaven students tumble through an Omenpath and wake the moon-headed Isilu, whose darkness spreads across the land.

The story follows Kirol, Tamira, Sanar and Abigale as they are scattered across the plane, while High Perfect Morcant plots to kill the night with dawnglow and Queen Maralen fears that Oona is returning and that her death pact with Rhys will end her.
Ajani comes from Arcavios to bring the students home, and in the final battle Oko saves Maralen with dawnglow, Isilu and Eirdu answer one another in play instead of war, and the night recedes.
